item.title: An Integrated Geospatial Framework for Spatio-Temporal Monitoring of Surface Albedo, Thermal and Vegetation Dynamics in Amrapali Coal-Mine Overburden, Eastern India
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Sonu Choudhary, Surojit Konar, Yogheshwar Mishra, Sharad Tiwari
Monitoring coal-mine rehabilitation primarily relies on single vegetation indices, which reflect greenness but overlook surface transitions that precede vegetation growth, and are rarely integrated into a reproducible spatio-temporal workflow. Surface albedo is a promising yet underutilized metric for early-stage reclamation, but integrated multi-indicator assessments remain sparse. This study addresses this gap for the Amrapali opencast coal-mine overburden in Chatra, Jharkhand, establishing a pre-restoration baseline (2013–2026). Annual composites of surface albedo, land surface temperature (LST) and NDVI were derived from Landsat imagery across a 10 km buffer, and land use/land cover (LULC) change was quantified (2015–2025). item.title: Isolation and Characterization of a Clinically-Derived Staphylococcus epidermidis HE23: Revealing Its Antibiotic Resistome and Metabolic Potential
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Xiaoyan Wang, Qingru Chen, Wenxin Lin, Yue Gao, Yunyi Qin, Dawei Gao 等8位作者
Neonatal incubators may serve as environmental reservoirs for antimicrobial-resistant bacteria in neonatal intensive care units. In this study, Staphylococcus epidermidis HE23 was isolated from a high-touch surface of a neonatal incubator and characterized using whole-genome sequencing, comparative genomics, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and metabolomic analysis. Hybrid assembly of Illumina and Nanopore sequencing reads generated a complete genome consisting of a circular chromosome (2,542,743 bp) and two plasmids (50,114 bp and 9,031 bp). Genomic analysis identified nine antibiotic resistance genes, including the chromosomal β-lactam resistance determinants blaZ and mecA and the plasmid-borne mupirocin resistance gene mupA.
